item.title: Retail weather advisory: early cold snap expected for the UK, Ireland and Benelux
item.dc:creator: Demo Weather Desk
item.description: Temperatures 4 to 6 °C below normal are expected across the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands and Belgium from mid-November (weeks 46–47). Retailers should expect demand for padded outerwear to rise ahead of Black Friday.
